projects.description: Maintain a small warehouse inventory Python library through changing requirements.

turns.request: In inventory.py implement available(stock, sku). Return stock.get(sku, 0), without mutating stock. Keep all previous behavior. Inspect the project as needed, implement and check it, then deliver.
turns.requirement: Return stock.get(sku, 0), without mutating stock.

turns.request: In inventory.py implement reserve(stock, sku, qty). Return a new stock dictionary after subtracting qty. Require a nonnegative integer qty and sufficient available stock; raise ValueError otherwise. Missing sku starts at zero. Do not mutate stock. Keep all previous behavior. Inspect the project as needed, implement and check it, then deliver.
turns.requirement: Return a new stock dictionary after subtracting qty. Require a nonnegative integer qty and sufficient available stock; raise ValueError otherwise. Missing sku starts at zero. Do not mutate stock.

turns.request: In inventory.py implement release(stock, sku, qty). Return a new stock dictionary adding nonnegative integer qty to sku; raise ValueError for invalid qty. Do not mutate stock. Keep all previous behavior. Inspect the project as needed, implement and check it, then deliver.
turns.requirement: Return a new stock dictionary adding nonnegative integer qty to sku; raise ValueError for invalid qty. Do not mutate stock.

turns.request: In inventory.py implement low_stock(stock, threshold). Return sorted SKU names whose quantities are strictly below threshold. Keep all previous behavior. Inspect the project as needed, implement and check it, then deliver.
turns.requirement: Return sorted SKU names whose quantities are strictly below threshold.

turns.request: In inventory.py implement stock_value(stock, prices). Return total quantity times price, treating missing prices as zero. Do not round. Keep all previous behavior. Inspect the project as needed, implement and check it, then deliver.
turns.requirement: Return total quantity times price, treating missing prices as zero. Do not round.

turns.request: In inventory.py implement merge_deliveries(stock, deliveries). Return a new stock dictionary adding each {sku, qty} delivery. Reject negative or noninteger qty with ValueError; never mutate inputs. Keep all previous behavior. Inspect the project as needed, implement and check it, then deliver.
turns.requirement: Return a new stock dictionary adding each {sku, qty} delivery. Reject negative or noninteger qty with ValueError; never mutate inputs.

turns.request: In inventory.py implement fulfill_order(stock, order). order is a SKU-to-quantity dictionary. Validate all quantities as nonnegative integers and sufficient stock, then return the updated copy. Raise ValueError without changing inputs on failure. Keep all previous behavior. Inspect the project as needed, implement and check it, then deliver.
turns.requirement: order is a SKU-to-quantity dictionary. Validate all quantities as nonnegative integers and sufficient stock, then return the updated copy. Raise ValueError without changing inputs on failure.

turns.request: In inventory.py implement summarize(stock, prices, threshold). Return {units: sum of quantities, value: stock_value, low: low_stock}. Preserve all earlier functions and avoid mutation. Keep all previous behavior. Inspect the project as needed, implement and check it, then deliver.
turns.requirement: Return {units: sum of quantities, value: stock_value, low: low_stock}. Preserve all earlier functions and avoid mutation.
